questions.question: In an election, a voter has choices to vote for one candidate out of three candidates. There is also an option ‘None Of The Above’ (NOTA) to reject all candidates. The three candidates get votes that are 6 times NOTA. The winner gets votes that are twice the second runner-up’s votes. The first runner-up gets 700 votes more than NOTA and defeats the second runner-up by 150 votes. What is the total number of votes polled?
questions.questionHtml:
In an election, a voter has choices to vote for one candidate out of three candidates. There is also an option ‘None Of The Above’ (NOTA) to reject all candidates. The three candidates get votes that are 6 times NOTA. The winner gets votes that are twice the second runner-up’s votes. The first runner-up gets 700 votes more than NOTA and defeats the second runner-up by 150 votes.
What is the total number of votes polled?
questions.solution:
Let NOTA = x
Then total votes = 7x (because A + B + C = 6x and NOTA = x)

1st Runner-up (B):
B = x + 700

2nd Runner-up (C):
C = x + 550

Winner (A):
A = 2 × (x + 550) = 1100 + 2x

Now,
A + B + C = 6x
⇒ (1100 + 2x) + (x + 700) + (x + 550) = 6x
⇒ 1100 + 700 + 550 + 4x = 6x
⇒ 2350 + 4x = 6x
⇒ 2x = 2350
⇒ x = 1175

Total votes = 7x = 7 × 1175 = 8225

questions.question: Ganesh is 5/3 times of Sita’s age. After 10 years, the ratio of Ganesh and Sita’s age is 14 : 10. Find Sita’s age 5 years ago.
questions.questionHtml: Ganesh is 5/3 times of Sita’s age. After 10 years, the ratio of Ganesh and Sita’s age is 14 : 10. Find Sita’s age 5 years ago.
questions.solution:
Let Sita’s present age = x years
Then Ganesh’s present age = (5/3) × x = 5x/3

After 10 years:

Given that their ages will then be in the ratio 14 : 10
⇒ (5x/3 + 10) / (x + 10) = 14 / 10
⇒ (5x/3 + 10) / (x + 10) = 7 / 5

Cross-multiply:
5 × (5x/3 + 10) = 7 × (x + 10)
⇒ (25x/3) + 50 = 7x + 70

Multiply both sides by 3 to remove the denominator:
25x + 150 = 21x + 210
⇒ 4x = 60
⇒ x = 15

So, Sita’s present age = 15 years.
Therefore, Sita’s age 5 years ago = 15 - 5 = 10 years.

questions.question: At a certain time of the day, a tree of 4.8 m height casts a shadow of 8 m. If a pole casts a shadow of 13.5 m at the same time, find the height of the pole.
questions.questionHtml: At a certain time of the day, a tree of 4.8 m height casts a shadow of 8 m. If a pole casts a shadow of 13.5 m at the same time, find the height of the pole.
questions.solution:
Let the height of the pole = x m

Since the sun rays are at the same angle,
the ratio of height to shadow length will be the same.

So,
4.8 / 8 = x / 13.5

⇒ x = (4.8 × 13.5) / 8
⇒ x = 8.1

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 15 days. A alone can complete it in 25 days. If B does not work for the first half of the day daily, then in how many days will A and B together complete the work?
questions.questionHtml: A and B together can complete a work in 15 days. A alone can complete it in 25 days. If B does not work for the first half of the day daily, then in how many days will A and B together complete the work?
questions.solution:
Let total work = LCM of 15 and 25 = 75 units

Then,

Since B does not work for the first half of the day,
B works only for half a day daily.

So B’s half-day work = 2 ÷ 2 = 1 unit per day

Thus, total daily work =
A’s full-day work (3 units) + B’s half-day work (1 unit) = 4 units/day

Total days = 75 ÷ 4 = 18¾ days

questions.question: Manoj and Navneet invest ₹1,20,000 and ₹2,40,000 respectively. After a year, the total profit including 10% interest is ₹66,000. Find Navneet’s share in the profit.
questions.questionHtml: Manoj and Navneet invest ₹1,20,000 and ₹2,40,000 respectively. After a year, the total profit including 10% interest is ₹66,000. Find Navneet’s share in the profit.
questions.solution:
Given:
Manoj = ₹1,20,000, Navneet = ₹2,40,000
Total profit (including 10% interest) = ₹66,000

Interest (10%)
10% of (1,20,000 + 2,40,000) = 10% of 3,60,000 = ₹36,000

Business profit
66,000 − 36,000 = ₹30,000

Profit ratio (Manoj : Navneet)
1,20,000 : 2,40,000 = 1 : 2

Navneet’s business profit = (2/3) × 30,000 = ₹20,000

Navneet’s interest = 10% of 2,40,000 = ₹24,000

Total share of Navneet
= 24,000 + 20,000 = ₹44,000

questions.question: The average weight of 8 persons increases by 3.5 kg when a new person replaces one of them weighing 55 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of 8 persons increases by 3.5 kg when a new person replaces one of them weighing 55 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.solution:
Given:
Average increases = 3.5 kg
Number of persons = 8
Weight of replaced person = 55 kg

Increase in total weight = 8 × 3.5 = 28 kg

New person’s weight = 55 + 28 = 83 kg

questions.question: A can complete the work in 8 days and B in 10 days. If they work together on it for 4 days, the remaining part of the work is __________.
questions.questionHtml: A can complete the work in 8 days and B in 10 days. If they work together on it for 4 days, the remaining part of the work is __________.
questions.solution:
Let total work = LCM of 8 and 10 = 40 units

A’s 1-day work = 40 ÷ 8 = 5 units
B’s 1-day work = 40 ÷ 10 = 4 units

⇒ A + B’s 1-day work = 5 + 4 = 9 units

Work done in 4 days = 9 × 4 = 36 units
Remaining work = 40 − 36 = 4 units

Remaining part = 4 / 40 = 1/10
